chunks: And from him (peace be upon him) said:
One who consoles a grieving person, will be clothed in the Standing Place [of Judgment] with a garment that will repair [his deficiencies].

key_terms.الْمَوْقِفِ: the Standing Place (referring to the Day of Judgment)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for consoling someone who is grieving?
ai.summary: In Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-A’mal*, this hadith highlights the spiritual efficacy of *ta’ziyah* (condolence), framing it as a divine compensation for one’s spiritual deficiencies. The 'garment' symbolizes the honor and protection granted by Allah on the Day of Resurrection, reflecting the Shia emphasis on social empathy as a means of attaining *kaffarah* (expiation) for sins.
